notifications.title: Weekly loop cycle 1 started: flag vs colour
notifications.detail: Your 19 Nov note asked to test both: half of this channel's Shorts now cover the country a line is about with its flag, half keep a flat colour (geo-flag-fill), judged on viewers held after the hook. At 2 Shorts a day, a verdict needs 8 a side, so about 8 days (by 27 Nov, or 3 Dec if extended). Also landed for every map Short: the country being talked about is traced by a glowing line that runs round its border and closes, and named people stand on the map as their photo heads.
notifications.fix: Nothing to do; the winner becomes the default automatically.
